09 / FAQ

Questions,
answered.

How do I place an order?+

Choose a product, click Order Now, enter your Fortnite/Epic username, then copy the generated order information and join the GameNest WhatsApp group.

Where do I send my order information?+

After joining the WhatsApp group, text the GameNest admin and send your copied order information to complete your order.

Do I need to pay on the website?+

No. This website only generates your order information. The admin will assist you with payment after you join the WhatsApp group.

What payment methods are supported?+

Vodafone Cash, WE Pay, InstaPay and Telda.
